pro_course_detail.description:

If you are currently reading a book in English and are unsure of your pronunciation, or you are not sure that you understand everything that is going on, I can help! In short, you will read, and I will systematically correct pronunciation errors. After we have finished a page, I will check your understanding of what you have just read and explain to the best of my ability anything that you have not understood. This technique is called "intensive reading" in the language community and coupled with "extensive reading" is a great way to expand your vocabulary.

Alternatively:
I will send you a short news article that you can read aloud to me. Then I will correct any pronunciation mistakes that you may have made, and finally, I will ask you some comprehension questions about the article to ensure that you have understood everything that has taken place.

Writing: I will send you a prompt before the lesson, and you will then have to write about the prompt in as much detail as you can muster (Usually aiming for around 200 - 300 words). Once the lesson begins, you will be able to read what you have written and we will then go over it together. Here we will fix any problems that we come across, such as word order, incorrect word usage, spelling errors, etc. I will also suggest possible vocab based on what you have written.

My Swahili methods work, and I’ve put them into practice teaching refugees and relatives of Swahili speakers living abroad. In addition to teaching Swahili, I’ve worked as a private music teacher and served as a university instructional assistant. My teaching is down-to-earth, direct, and to-the-point. But I also embrace the importance of humor in the learning process! I’m motivated to ensure you are well-equipped to reach your Swahili language goals.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I prioritize teaching family members and relatives of Swahili speakers using the best Swahili language resources I’ve researched during my real-life language immersion. Lessons focus on conversational Swahili. Beginners start with Swahili greetings– an important cultural custom. Then we dive into the most practical phrases, focusing on listening, speaking, and reading, while naturally integrating grammar, verb tenses and intonation. With my curriculum, you will learn practical “daily life” Swahili– NOT rote memorization or repeat outdated textbook "tourist" Swahili. I teach to prove that authentic, current-day Swahili is fun, and it isn't difficult to speak like a local Swahili speaker.

pro_course_detail.title: 📣 New Student Discount 📣 Mazungumzo kwa Kiswahili 💯 100% Kiswahili Conversation Practice 🗣️
pro_course_detail.description:
Virtual Reality tours, 📸 Graphic Novels, 💥 and more– This is a stress-free guided conversation practice that is 100% in Kiswahili. 🗣️💬 You'll know you're ready when you can do most things in my Foundations of Kiswahili course (you are approaching level A2+) and you can understand answers and phrases of slowly and carefully spoken Kiswahili directed towards you. No English needed. 🗑🔥

👉 Let's talk about: daily routines, recent activities and events, language learning, music and movies, something or someone in popular culture– even history and current world events! You can also come to class with specific grammar areas of Kiswahili that you want to practice through conversation. I enjoy talking about culture and society, anthropology, history and world events, and I love learning new things.

👉 We can go on adventures by reading original stories, a Comic Book, or Graphic Novel together 100% in Kiswahili! 💥📚 Through music and images, we can check out the environment of Lake Tanganyika and its towns, villages, and farms from of my years of research and living in Kigoma, Tanzania! 📸 🌴 We can take Virtual Reality tours using videos, 360º photographs, and Google Maps! 

We will develop more complicated grammar such as verb extensions, conditional and compound tenses, negative tense in past and future, the location noun class, compare noun classes, and build professional and academic vocabulary for research or work. I'm confident I can get you to a B2-C1 level in the time your personal commitment allows you to, where you feel comfortable not using English with native speakers. 

I use the Comprehensible Input (Krashen) and Total Physical Response (Asher) theories in language learning.💡🙌 You will be surprised how much you understand with visuals, dynamic gestures, miming, and props to create an interactive experience as we converse together, and talk about stories and pictures. I can write new vocab in the chat and send you a document after each lesson. 📄
